verdict.rationale: CDP documents sending payouts and disbursements from a custodial account to onchain addresses or email recipients (docs-3, docs-23), and paying out USDC onchain to any wallet via the CLI or SDK (docs-20, docs-7). General real-time webhooks (docs-15, docs-24) suggest a way to track events, but there is no documented transfer status lifecycle through to final settlement. Missing for 10: a documented payout status/settlement lifecycle, explicit stored-recipient or address-book support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
